name: Michaelis Paul
source:
A member of the Special Guard, [url=/c43608]Jearl's[/url] right hand man.
His true form is of the Archangel Michael.
Ruling over fire, he's a passionate guy that always gives things everything he's got.
A so called muscle-head who doesn't use his brain much, he leaves the important decisions up to Jearl.
He loves fighting and he's recently started up a grudge against [url=/c43597]Beel[/url].
